reason: Names the owner's own Google OAuth client file while gcal bundles no app of its own; drive-cli has the same option in its baseline. Review when gcal ships the shared WireCat Google app or the vocabulary names an app-credential file: https://github.com/WireCatLabs/cli-base/issues/424

Calls one generated Google method by its API name, the same command drive-cli has (in its baseline); no shared verb names a raw API call. Review when the vocabulary names it: https://github.com/WireCatLabs/cli-base/issues/425

Chooses where the sign-in is kept, keyring or a private file, for computers without a keyring; drive-cli has the same option in its baseline. Comes out with the cli-base release that adds the word: https://github.com/WireCatLabs/cli-base/pull/419

Lists the few profiles on this computer, every one at once by design (WC-ACCT-12); a filter would let a caller narrow it to one and read that as the only profile. Review if a computer commonly holds more profiles than fit one screen.
